object.attr: derived: a document that can't be read can't be validated. The window's copy can still load when the files don't, after a pull while the window stayed active (CF-C45, D-C19), and `commit_changes` can commit a file with conflict markers. Merges CHECK's two (MELLON-CHECK-SRS-83 and its Document Editor one; review Q3, Q29 there).
object.description: If a document holding a selected path of a commit has a load error, Mellon shall refuse the commit and report the load error.
